newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh's half-yearly imports drop by 4.51 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh's half-yearly imports drop by 4.51 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh's half yearly imports to December declined by 4.51 percent to 132.22 billion taka compared with the same period of 1995 due to sharp drop in foodgrain import, the Bangladesh Bank (central bank) said on Thursday.
Imports of foodgrains and finished consumers goods dropped by more than 40 percent during the period.
Imports of industrial raw materials and petroleum products, on the contrary, rose by nearly 16 percent.
